art.title: POV: your first tax-free shopping in Japan

gags: freeze snap inside a moving clip (clerk and shoppers freeze staring at the hands tearing the tax-free bag open, neon sign flickering and shoppers keep moving)
WRONG WAY / RIGHT WAY verdict stamps (overlays on moving footage)
silence-to-shout (female clerk, female voice: 開けちゃダメですよ！ / Don't open it!)
the wait (clerk seals a fresh bag with tape and shoppers browse while the POV fist waits)
punchline: open it after Japan, not before.
pdca.hook: You rip open the sealed tax-free bag. The clerk freezes.
